content:
mohit: Heads-up — incoming pen-test intake from RedHorse next week. Need to lock down RBAC scope, KMS access pattern, and log packaging. Can we confirm retest windows? cc @dina @ashley :wave
dina: Thanks. Quick clarifying q — scope staging only or sandbox too? any on-prem connectors included?
mohit: Staging + sandbox infra only. No on-prem. They requested short-lived KMS decrypt for evidence proofs. We should only grant via ephemeral role (no static keys).
carla: Strong +1 for ephemeral. Also: we should presign S3 evidence links (24h TTL) and require an evidence_manifest.json that includes sha256s of artifacts. Put audits into sec-audit-bucket/pentest-exports/
ashley: Also need to bump audit retention for the retest window. Can we make a 30-day snapshot for SIEM ingest and hand off a long-term export to assessors? @samir any cost concerns?
samir: 30 days is ok. 90 days is expensive. Suggest: 30 days hot retention, then cold archive snapshot we hand to assessor if needed. Keeps cost reasonable.
mohit: Plan outline: create ephemeral role `assessor/ephemeral` scoped to s3:GetObject on `evidence/pentest/redhorse/*`, kms:Decrypt on `alias/pentest-evidence-key` with condition on sourceIp and time window, logs:DescribeStreams + GetLogEvents on audit-log group. Rotate role credentials hourly. Any objections?
dina: No objections. Two operational reqs: 1) runbook for oncall in case assessor triggers noisy alerts; 2) a pause/play mechanism if production alert rate spikes (do-not-block fallback).
ashley: Runbook should include these quick commands and checks:
```bash
# assume role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/assessor-ephemeral --role-session-name redhorse-2026
# download evidence
curl "<presigned-s3-url>" -o artifact.tar.gz
# verify manifest
sha256sum -c evidence_manifest.json
```
mohit: i'll commit a runbook page in /docs/pt-retest/runbooks and wire the pause/play via a feature-flag + terraform var. Also will add an automated export task: `audit-export --from 2026-05-05T09:00 --to 2026-05-05T17:00 --dest s3://sec-audit-bucket/pentest-exports/redhorse/`
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled pen-test window 2026-05-05 09:00-17:00 UTC. Paging policy set to `security-oncall`.
carla: Retest proposals: 2026-05-12 09:00-12:00 UTC or 2026-05-19 09:00-12:00 UTC. I can block both and we pick based on assessor availability. We'll create a canary staging snapshot 1h before start. :calendar:
samir: I'll add a quick cost note for audit retention and presigned egress to the intake doc and ping finance for approval if we go beyond the baseline.
dina: I'll draft the intake email + evidence_manifest template and circulate for approvals today. Then we can formalize ephemeral role policy and the runbook.
mohit: thanks all — action items: @dina draft intake, @carla block retest slots & snapshot, @ashley update runbook commands + SIEM retention, @samir cost note. I'll create the ephemeral role PR and link here.
carla: fwiw, include a small checklist in the PR: [ephemeral role], [presigned bucket], [manifest present], [audit export scheduled], [runbook linked]. Keeps verification quick during handoff. :white_check_mark:
